content.short: Nethermind is an Ethereum execution client written in the C#.NET tech stack.
content.description: Nethermind is a full-service Ethereum execution client written in C#.NET, built to be practical and reliable for developers and operators. Developers using Nethermind can leverage its optimized virtual machine, Ethereum state access, and the Nethermind Grafana dashboard for visibility into performance and behavior. Built on Nethermind’s .NET Core platform, the client is well-suited for enterprise use and easily integrated into existing systems, supporting scalable deployment within established tech stacks.

resources.title: How We Formalized Ethereum Execution: A Semantics of the EVM and Yul in Lean
resources.tldr: Writing a machine-checked formal model of the EVM in a proof assistant. Dense, serious work, and a rare look at what verifying a virtual machine takes.
